hysteria2.notes: Xray accepted the v2 config schema only when streamSettings.network is hysteria and hysteriaSettings is present. No controlled UDP/TLS peer was available, so connectivity is not verified; UDP egress and obfuscation remain unsupported claims.

limitations: TUIC is not supported in v1.
Shared engine is a single point of failure for all running profiles.
Management API is loopback-only and has no application-level authentication.

Only VLESS over TCP was end-to-end exercised through the shared engine; other VLESS transports and VMess/Shadowsocks/Trojan/basic/WireGuard mappings are not verified and are intentionally absent from this manifest.
